answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens to audit transactions across network clusters. Game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces stake slashing against dishonest colluders, while topological cut verifications identify sparse bottlenecks—analogous to isolating a narrow jetty or a sable chasm—preventing fake identities from faking high connectivity. Anchoring validation paths to scarce jade token deposits imposes superlinear attacker cost.
